_dataSources.note: All cover figures use DFRS national forest definition (5,963,412 ha baseline 2015). Annual loss uses real GFW/UMD Landsat values. Annual gain calibrated to DFRS/REDD+ net gain ~35,000 ha/yr.
_dataSources.forestCover: DFRS (2015) State of Nepal Forests â€” 5,963,412 ha; DFRS physiographic breakdown Terai 1,217,764 / Hills 2,820,324 / Mountains 1,925,324 ha
_dataSources.forestLoss: Global Forest Watch / UMD Landsat (Hansen et al. Science 2013, updated annually). Annual tree cover loss 2015-2024: real published values. 2025: estimated avg of 2022-2024.
_dataSources.forestGain: Calibrated to Nepal REDD+ Forest Reference Level (UNFCCC 2017): net gain ~35,000 ha/yr under DFRS national definition. Gross gain = GFW loss + net gain.
_dataSources.provinces: Province cover shares from DFRS (2015) regional reports. Springer Gandaki study (2021): 7,778 km2 forest in 2016 = 777,800 ha (corrected from erroneous 1,124,588 ha). MDPI Lumbini study (2021): 9,491 km2 in 1996, growing to 9,691 km2 by 2016 = 969,100 ha.
_dataSources.districts: DFRS Forest Cover Maps of Local Levels (2018); cover proportional to DFRS province baselines; loss/gain weighted by physiographic pressure (Terai > Hills > Mountains).
_dataSources.gfw_loss_2025: ESTIMATED â€” GFW 2025 data not yet published as of Aug 2026. Value is average of 2022-2024 GFW figures.
